## File: NousResearch_hermes-agent/optional-skills/creative/meme-generation/scripts/generate_meme.py

Prompts

```
['create a meme image by overlaying text on a curated or imgflip template and save to a file', 'create a meme image from a custom image path with optional black text bars above and below', 'list all curated meme templates with custom text positioning from templates.json', 'search all imgflip meme templates by name query and display matching results', 'generate a meme from a template id with multiple text arguments and output path']
```

Usage

```
{'create_meme_from_template': 'create a meme image by overlaying text on a curated or imgflip template and save to a file', 'create_meme_from_custom_image': 'create a meme image from a custom image path with optional black text bars above and below', 'list_curated_templates': 'list all curated meme templates with custom text positioning from templates.json', 'search_imgflip_templates': 'search all imgflip meme templates by name query and display matching results', 'generate_meme_with_text': 'generate a meme from a template id with multiple text arguments and output path'}
```
